description: Individuals in this job are responsible for designing, maintaining, evaluating, and testing architectures of cloud products and solutions. Cloud Architects also create enterprise policies and guidelines for cloud implementation and governance. They assess cloud vendors and third-party cloud service providers. They also assist in validating customer proposals and project plans for cloud implementation.
awardingBodyName: Nasscom  National Association of Software and Service Companies

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Integrate cloud infrastructure with existing IT systems.
Migrate legacy/on-premises/cloud applications and data to new cloud platforms
Maintain compute, network, and storage systems deployed on the cloud and ensure backup and recovery
Provision, configure, test, and deploy cloud infrastructure.
